passages.text: The lake reached a maximum of 638,000 square metres on July 7.
By July 8, following the rupture, the lake had shrunk to 435,000 square metres.
Satellite analysis traced the ponds atop the Pyurepu Glacier back to first appearance on 21 December 2023, at roughly 5,100 metres elevation about 35 km north of the Nepal-China border.

source.publisher: Institute of Mountain Hazards and Environment (Chinese Academy of Sciences), as reported
